name: Excalidraw
title: Excalidraw: free Miro alternative
hook: Miro charges you ten bucks a month to sketch on whiteboards with your team. This app does it for free.

features.say: It's an endless whiteboard with shapes, arrows and text.
Share a link and draw together, live. It's end-to-end encrypted.
Export your drawing as a PNG or SVG. It even works offline.

install_line: It runs in any browser. Nothing to install.
caption:
Miro Starter charges $10/month. Excalidraw lets you sketch on a whiteboard with your team for free ✏️

✅ Endless whiteboard with shapes, arrows and text
✅ Live collaboration with a shared link, end-to-end encrypted
✅ Export to PNG or SVG, and it works offline
✅ No sign-up, no install, no subscription, 100% free

💻 Any browser
ℹ️ There's also a separate paid Excalidraw+ with extra cloud features. The free app is fully usable without it.

Comment "DRAW" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day

#opensource #github #whiteboard #diagrams #productivity #freeapps #techtips
dm_pitch: Excalidraw, the free open-source Miro alternative for whiteboards ✏️
